production: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for cozy farming RPG. Reference image 1 is style reference only: choose ONLY wooden beehives from its upper A row, no labels or background. Make ONE square 3 by 3 transparent atlas, NINE separated sprite cutouts. Top row from left: A level 1 modest single-box honey-brown wooden hive on short legs with pitched wood roof and dark small entrance; level 2 same hive with two stacked wood boxes; level 3 same hive with three boxes, reinforced corners, pollen tray. All three same slightly elevated south-facing orthographic camera and SAME compact square ground footprint, centered silhouettes grow upward only, identical base width. Middle row: left a compact hollow tree stump wild bee nest with visible golden comb inside and tiny opening (no full tree/no branches); center a small isolated golden black striped honeybee with wings icon; right a golden chunk of honey-filled hexagonal comb icon. Bottom row: left two small soft golden beeswax blocks, center a tiny rustic ceramic bowl of golden pollen granules, right a small brown irregular propolis resin lump. Same painterly outlined warm rustic style, clear forms at small sizes. VERY WIDE genuinely transparent gutters and outside padding around every cell; all silhouettes fully within own cell. True transparent alpha, not brown/black painted backdrop. No lettering, no badges, no UI frames, no scenery, no flying bees elsewhere, no ground plane. Tiny tight contact shadows only. Exact nine objects, no duplicates. Main hive levels are practical wooden A modular design, not woven/skep styles.
design: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cozy farming RPG BEEHIVE design comparison, reusable separate sprite cutouts. Landscape sheet, transparent background, 3 columns and 2 rows. Warm painterly outlined game style matching rustic wood, red brick, wrought iron in this game's farmhouse workshop; readable and modest details, not coarse pixel art. Same slightly elevated orthographic south-facing camera, same compact square footprint all six silhouettes, all fully inside separate cells with very wide transparent gutters and outside margin. Upper row A: A1 compact practical rectangular natural honey-brown wooden beehive on short legs, dark little entrance slot, pitched wooden roof; A2 same hive with two stacked rectangular hive boxes and slightly nicer roof; A3 same hive with three modular boxes, reinforced tidy corners and pollen tray, practical compact advanced apiary hive. Lower row B: B1 traditional straw skep woven dome on tiny wooden stand; B2 larger woven skep with small wood shingle rain canopy on posts; B3 advanced woven skep in compact timber rain shelter with tidy hive tool shelf. No decorative fantasy runes, no glowing magic, no giant house. No people, no bees flying outside silhouettes, no background, no ground, no UI panel. Only isolated sprites and small dark brown corner badges with legible ivory labels exactly A1 A2 A3 above and B1 B2 B3 below. Tight subtle contact shadows, transparent alpha throughout all gutters. Variant A is intended to suit the selected practical rustic workshop design.
